mapper.sql:
insert into batch.workflow_run ( tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, trigger_request_id, single_job_definition_id, related_job_instance_id, biz_date, run_status, current_node_code, trace_id, dry_run, workflow_version_snapshot, data_interval_start, data_interval_end, execution_snapshot ) values ( #{tenantId}, #{workflowDefinitionId}, #{triggerRequestId}, #{singleJobDefinitionId}, #{relatedJobInstanceId}, #{bizDate}, #{runStatus}, #{currentNodeCode}, #{traceId},
#{dryRun} false , #{workflowVersionSnapshot}, #{dataIntervalStart}, #{dataIntervalEnd}, CAST(#{executionSnapshot} AS jsonb) )
mapper.insert: on conflict (tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, biz_date, dry_run) where run_status in ('CREATED', 'RUNNING') do nothing
mapper.select: select workflow_run.* from batch.workflow_run workflow_run join batch.workflow_node_run node_run on node_run.workflow_run_id = workflow_run.id and node_run.job_instance_id = #{jobInstanceId} where workflow_run.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_run.related_job_instance_id is null order by workflow_run.id desc limit 1

select workflow_run.* from batch.workflow_run workflow_run where workflow_run.tenant_id = #{tenantId} and workflow_run.execution_snapshot is not null and exists ( select 1 from jsonb_each(coalesce(workflow_run.execution_snapshot -> 'jobDefinitions', '{}'::jsonb)) as job_snapshot(node_code, identity) where job_snapshot.identity -> 'executionDefinition' ->> 'id' = cast(#{jobDefinitionId} as text) and job_snapshot.identity -> 'executionDefinition' ->> 'jobCode' = #{jobCode} and job_snapshot.identity -> 'executionDefinition' ->> 'version' = cast(#{jobDefinitionVersion} as text) ) order by workflow_run.created_at desc, workflow_run.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update batch.workflow_run set run_status = #{runStatus}, current_node_code = #{currentNodeCode}, started_at = coalesce(started_at, #{startedAt}), updated_at = current_timestamp where tenant_id = #{tenantId} and id = #{id} and run_status in ('CREATED','RUNNING')
mapper.insert: insert into archive.workflow_run_archive ( id, tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, single_job_definition_id, related_job_instance_id, biz_date, run_status, current_node_code, trace_id, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at, dry_run, trigger_request_id, workflow_version_snapshot, data_interval_start, data_interval_end, execution_snapshot ) select id, tenant_id, workflow_definition_id, single_job_definition_id, related_job_instance_id, biz_date, run_status, current_node_code, trace_id, started_at, finished_at, created_at, updated_at, dry_run, trigger_request_id, workflow_version_snapshot, data_interval_start, data_interval_end, execution_snapshot from batch.workflow_run where id in #{id} on conflict (id) do nothing

insert into archive.workflow_node_run_archive ( id, workflow_run_id, job_instance_id, node_code, node_type, run_seq, node_status, retry_count, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, output, error_key, error_args, skip_reason_code, skip_reason, sensor_next_probe_at, sensor_last_probe_at, sensor_probe_count, sensor_error_count, source_payload_protected ) select id, workflow_run_id, job_instance_id, node_code, node_type, run_seq, node_status, retry_count, error_code, error_message, started_at, finished_at, duration_ms, output, error_key, error_args, skip_reason_code, skip_reason, sensor_next_probe_at, sensor_last_probe_at, sensor_probe_count, sensor_error_count, source_payload_protected from batch.workflow_node_run where workflow_run_id in #{id} on conflict (id) do nothing
mapper.select: select (select count(*) from batch.workflow_run hot left join archive.workflow_run_archive cold on cold.id = hot.id where hot.id in #{id} and to_jsonb(hot) is distinct from to_jsonb(cold)) + (select count(*) from batch.workflow_node_run hot left join archive.workflow_node_run_archive cold on cold.id = hot.id where hot.workflow_run_id in #{id} and to_jsonb(hot) is distinct from to_jsonb(cold))
